source.title: Lurgan Mail, 19 May 1961, p. 3 ("No contests in rural areas")
source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the no-contests report read in the Lurgan Mail of 19 May 1961.

note: Triennial election of Moira Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. There was no contest in any division; the Lurgan Mail prints the representative returned for each of the seven divisions. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Maralin' to Magheralin (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Moira Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Magheralin; the rounds were filed as Magheralin (1899, 1924, 1927, 1946, 1955, 1958); Marlin (1930, 1967); Maralin (1949, 1952, 1961, 1964). This round was filed as 'Maralin', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (maralin) answers with a redirect to this one.
